name: @red-cup-engineering/computer-game-presence-services-section
description: The cross-game presence/chat primitive every house game parameterizes instead of rolling its own: per-game player status (who's online), channels (subscribe/broadcast), and tells (cross-game direct messages), offered once as a shared service. Agent players are first-class (a session's client is any duck-typed { send(obj):bool }, never assumed to be a human's browser socket) and every presence/chat event lands in an append-only log built on cartridge's intent-log discipline (kind-enveloped, monotonic-seq, canonically-stringified entries), so a game's presence/chat history replays the same way its own intent log does. Built on qwzspace's broadcast-hub for the live client set and best-effort fan-out.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
